```python
def get_gene_list_values(df: pl.DataFrame) -> List[str]:
    """Extract all unique gene list names from target_gene_lists and partner_gene_lists columns.
    
    Returns:
        Sorted list of unique list names (e.g., ["competitor_target", "pioneer_novel", "spotlight"])
    """
    all_lists = set()
    for col in ["target_gene_lists", "partner_gene_lists"]:
        if col in df.columns:
            values = df[col].drop_nulls().to_list()
            for val in values:
                if val:
                    for item in str(val).split(","):
                        item = item.strip()
                        if item:
                            all_lists.add(item)
    return sorted(all_lists)


def filter_by_gene_list(df: pl.DataFrame, list_name: str) -> pl.DataFrame:
    """Filter to pairs where at least one gene belongs to the specified list.
    
    Args:
        df: Input DataFrame
        list_name: Gene list name to filter by (e.g., "pioneer_novel")
    
    Returns:
        Filtered DataFrame
    """
    target_match = pl.col("target_gene_lists").cast(pl.Utf8).str.contains(list_name, literal=True)
    partner_match = pl.col("partner_gene_lists").cast(pl.Utf8).str.contains(list_name, literal=True)
    return df.filter(target_match | partner_match)
```
